summary.bn: রোবটের চাকার জন্য গিয়ারবক্সওয়ালা ছোট মোটর: 3 V থেকে 6 V, 6 V-এ প্রায় 250 RPM।
summary.en: A small geared motor for robot wheels: 3 V to 6 V, about 250 RPM at 6 V.

simplified: Its speed is in proportion to its voltage, about 42 RPM a volt at the shaft, from one maker's measurements of one motor (REPORTED); motors vary.

It is one resistance, set so that it draws the 155 mA measured at 4.5 V. A real one draws about 150 to 160 mA running free at any voltage from 3 V to 6 V, so the lab is about a third low at 3 V and a third high at 6 V.
Nothing holds it back: it always runs free. Held still, a real one draws 1.1 A to 1.5 A, which is not modelled.
It reaches its speed at once; a real one takes a moment.
